notes:
Docket 1.3.85

**Fewer false alarms on shops and blogs.**

- *Your products reported as competing pages.* A range of products from one
  maker — each on its own page, with its own price and its own "Add to cart" —
  was grouped as pages chasing one search, with advice to merge them. Two pages
  that each sell one thing are now two products. Sold-out products count too:
  their button still marks them as a product page.
- *"No Open Graph tags"* on pages that set their share image but not a share
  title. The finding now says exactly which tag is missing, and no longer warns
  about the wrong image being shown when the image is the part you set.
- *"Placeholder text is live"* because of a reader's comment. Text in a blog's
  comment thread is other people's writing — a sign-off like "xxxxx" there is
  not your unfinished copy. The same text in your own post is still reported.
- *Two different recipes as competing pages* because both titles call the
  recipe "ultimate" or "best". Words that grade a recipe no longer count as
  what it is about; the same dish written up twice is still reported.

99 checks across 13 areas.
